
# Implementation Plan: Interactive Demo - Use flasgger

**Branch**: `005-interactive-demo-use` | **Date**: 2025-10-12 | **Spec**: [/specs/005-interactive-demo-use/spec.md]
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/005-interactive-demo-use/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan is generated by the `/speckit.plan` command.

## Summary

Provide an interactive demo web UI for API documentation and testing using flasgger, auto-generating the UI from Flask blueprints and routes. The demo is enabled or disabled via an environment variable and requires no ongoing manual maintenance. Each endpoint is described for usability. The technical approach leverages standard Flask and flasgger integration patterns.


## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Python 3.12+
**Primary Dependencies**: Flask, flasgger
**Storage**: N/A (no persistent storage required for demo)
**Testing**: pytest, Behave (BDD), Playwright (for BDD acceptance testing of the Flasgger UI)
**Target Platform**: Linux server
**Project Type**: web
**Performance Goals**: Demo UI loads in <1s for 95% of users; API calls via UI complete in <2s
**Constraints**: Demo must not require ongoing manual maintenance (no manual updates to documentation or code required for new endpoints); must be toggled by environment variable
## Security & Error Handling

- Demo UI must only be enabled in non-production environments or require authentication in production.
- Error response formats and handling for all API failures (4xx, 5xx, validation errors) must be specified in the demo UI and documentation.
**Scale/Scope**: Supports all API endpoints in the Flask app; expected usage by developers and testers


## Constitution Check

All gates pass:
- Spec-driven development: Feature spec is complete and approved.
- System engineering baseline: Requirements and acceptance criteria are defined.
- Test-first: Unit and acceptance tests will be written before implementation.
- Automation & CI/CD: All builds/tests are automated; Python env managed with uv; ruff for linting.
- Documentation: Demo UI and API docs are self-updating; maintainers will document the env variable.
